approved_scope: Removing a hard-coded provider dependency from a mandatory verification gate is distinct from weakening or removing the gate. The flexible role must preserve actor separation, capability fit, mandatory verification, human/runtime gates, Mission Control acceptance and Founder authority.

evidence.locator: 'Approved architecture': 'The lifecycle role becomes: Mission Control-appointed Independent Verification Actor subject to: no self-verification; actual contribution separation; capability fit; explicit Mission Control appointment; preserved human runtime verification; preserved Mission Control runtime review; preserved Stage 19; ... preserved Mission Control acceptance; preserved Founder authority.'

Section 2, 'Source 18 v1.1': 'Stage 19 remains mandatory and is owned by: Mission Control-appointed Independent Verification Actor subject to actual contribution separation, capability fit, explicit appointment, no self-verification, no self-approval and preserved higher-authority gates.' Section 3, 'Critical interpretation: Codex Not Required != Independent Verification Not Required'.

Section 4.9, 'Independent Verification Actor': 'Codex is preferred for the highest-risk cases where eligible and available; Claude Code or another approved actor may be appointed when the same independence and capability conditions are satisfied.'
